title: Determination 2024/014: Compliance of a stormwater tank near a property boundary with Building Code clauses concerning fire affecting other areas
jurisdiction: New Zealand: Consentium as building consent authority for a site at Henderson, Auckland; MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004. Non-Alberta comparative record.
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992), clauses C3.6 and C3.7 (fire affecting areas beyond the fire source). No Acceptable Solution edition is named in the text read.

facts.text: A new two-storey detached building is to be built on a future lot at Henderson, Auckland. The owner applied for building consent, and a stormwater tank was proposed near the property boundary.
The stormwater tank originally proposed was a particular plastic tank. The building consent application was amended to a metal tank to enable the consent to be granted.
The determination arises from the authority's view about the stormwater tank proposed near the boundary, in relation to fire between properties.
The matter is whether the tank near the boundary, as proposed, complies with clauses C3.6 and C3.7 of Clause C3 Fire affecting areas beyond the fire source.
